Salam Arjun,

Jurong Regional Library se is hafte ki nayi list aa gayi hai. Judwa bachchon wale papa ke liye kuch khaas chuna hai humne.

### Chhote bachchon wali picture books

**1. Goodnight, Little Twin Stars**
Do chhote sitaaron ki sone ki kahani — Aarav aur Vivaan ko sunane ke liye ekdum sahi. Tasveerein badi-badi hain, neend se pehle padhne me maza aayega.

Ek papa jo judwa bachchon ko stroller me ghumata hai, bazaar le jata hai. Aapko apni kahani lagegi, hasi bhi aayegi.

Raat me baar-baar jagna, feed ka time, jhula vs bistar — chhote-chhote tips me samjhaya hai. Hindi aur English dono version me available hai.

**2. 4 Mahine se 1 Saal tak Khana aur Teeka Guide**
Wazan kaise badhta hai, teeke ke baad bukhar aaye to kya karna hai — polyclinic wali tension yahan aasan bhasha me likhi hai.

## Telegram - Apna account safe rakho, 2-step verification on karo

Namaste,

Aapke Telegram account ki safety ke liye ek chhoti reminder. Bahut log sirf OTP par bharosa karte hain, par SIM change ya purana phone bechne par account khul sakta hai.

### 2-step password kaise on karein

- Telegram app kholo > **Settings > Privacy and Security > Two-Step Verification** par jao
- **Set Password** dabao, ek password likho jo OTP ke baad manga jayega
- Hint aur recovery email zaroor dalo, taaki password bhoolo to wapas mil jaye

Ek baar on ho gaya to naya phone me login par OTP ke saath ye password bhi lagega.

### Unknown device dikhe to kya karna hai

- **Settings > Devices** me dekho kaun se phone ya laptop par aapka account khula hai
- Jo device pehchano nahi, us par tap karke **Terminate Session** karo
- Uske baad turant Two-Step password badal lo

Agar aapko bina OTP maange koi login alert aaye to turant logout karo aur [Support se sampark karo](https://telegram.org)

body:
## NHS Parenting Tips - 4 mahine ke judwa wala week

Namaste Arjun,

judwa ke saath neend poori karna mushkil hai, par thoda routine se dono ko sambhalna aasaan ho jata hai. Is hafte aapke liye khaas tips laaye hain.

### 1. Ek roye to dusre ko kaise sambhalein

Pehle jo tez ro raha hai usko kandhe par lekar halka walk karo, dusre ko swing ya stroller me safe lita do. Dono ko ek saath god me lene ki jaldi mat karo, pehle ek shaant hoga to dusra khud dheela pad jayega. Raat me light dim rakhna aur ek hi lori roz bajana, judwa usi sound se sonaa seekh jaate hain.

### 2. Ek saath sulane ki 3 asaan tricks

**Pehli trick - Same time sulao:** Dono ka sone ka time ek rakho, chahe ek ko thoda jaga kar sulao. Aadat banne me 4-5 din lagte hain par baad me bahut aaraam milta hai.

**Dusri trick - Tandem feed:** Pehle ek ko aadha feed kara kar burp ke liye side me lita do, phir dusre ko pilao. Dono ka pet ek saath bharega to neend bhi ek saath aayegi.

**Teesri trick - White noise:** Fan ya phone par halki rain sound chalao. Bahar ke food court wale shor se bachche uthte nahi hain.

### 3. Feed-neend copy me note karne ka simple format

Aapki feed-neend copy ke liye ye line roz likho, 10 Sep wale review me nurse ko dikhane me kaam aayega:

- **Time - Kaun - Kitna ml / kitni der - Susu / Potty - Neend**
- Jaise: *2pm - Aarav - 120ml - susu 1 - 1.5 hr soya*

Dono ke liye alag page mat banao, ek hi page par A / V likh kar note karo, time bachega.

### 4. Mummy-ji ke liye kamar-dard tip

Bachche ko neeche se uthate time ghutna mod kar uthao, kamar jhuka kar mat uthao. Sulane ke baad 5 minute gunguna kapda kamar par rakho aur pairon ke neeche takiya laga kar 10 minute seedha leto. Dard badhe to polyclinic me physio se pooch lena.

## 4-6 Mahine: Semi-solid shuru karne se pehle doctor se kab poochein

Namaste papa,

Aarav aur Vivaan ab 4 mahine ke aas-paas hain, to sab puchte honge - upar ka khana kab shuru karoge? Jaldi mat karo, pehle sanket samjho.

### Kya bachcha taiyaar hai? 3 sanket

**1. Gardan sambhalna**
Bina support ke sir seedha rakhe, idhar-udhar ghumaye. Ye sabse pehla sign hai.

**2. Cheezon me interest**
Aap khana khao to gaur se dekhe, haath badhaye, munh chalaye. Sirf dekhna kaafi nahi, gardan wala point bhi hona chahiye.

**3. Doodh ke baad bhi bhookh**
Feed ka time aur quantity sahi hone ke baad bhi baar-baar mangna. Is par polyclinic me wazan check ke baad hi decide karo.

### Polyclinic review me kya poochein - chhoti checklist

Agli baar Jurong Polyclinic jao to ye 3 sawaal zaroor poochna:

- Dono ka wazan curve par theek badh raha hai kya?
- Pehla semi-solid kya dein - chawal ka paani ya mashed dal ya fruit puree?
- Ek naya khana kitne din dekh kar doosra shuru karein?

Apni feed-neend wali copy saath le jao, doctor ko samjhane me aasaan hoga.

### Dal-paani myth par note

Bahut log kehte hain patli dal ka paani pilao, wahi kaafi hai. Sach ye hai ki sirf paani me poshan bahut kam hota hai. Jab doctor haan bole, tab mashed dal, soft khichdi ka gaaddh'aa hissa dena zyada sahi hai. Paani-pani cheez se pet bharta hai, taakat nahi milti.

Aur yaad rakho, 6 mahine tak maa ka doodh ya formula hi main khana hai, upar ka khana sirf taste sikhne ke liye hai.

body:
## HDB ghar-care: barish me ghar ko seelan se bachao

Namaste neighbour,

September me barish thodi zyada ho rahi hai, to is hafte hum bathroom me hawa ka flow aur almari me nami rokne ki baat kar rahe hain. Chhoti aadat se bada kharcha bach jata hai.

### 1. Nahane ke baad exhaust fan 20 minute chalao

Bahut log fan turant band kar dete hain, isse chhat par paani jama ho jata hai. Tum timer laga do, darwaza thoda khula rakho taaki hawa bahar nikle.

### 2. Bathroom ki tile line har hafte check karo

Kone me kala nishan dikhe to sirka aur baking soda se saaf kar do. Agar grout ukhad gaya hai to apne se cement mat bharo, photo le kar rakho.

### 3. Almari me hawa aane do

Barish ke din me kapde thode geele almari me mat thunso. Neeche newspaper bichha do, ek chhota dehumidifier box ya charcoal pack rakho. Hafte me ek baar darwaza 1-2 ghante khula chhodo.

### 4. Khidki ka rubber aur drain mat bhoolo

Subah-shaam 15 minute cross-ventilation karo. Service yard ka drain patta-phool se band ho to khud haath se nikal do, paani reverse na aaye.

### Town Council ko kab phone karo?

- Chhat se paani tapak raha hai ya lift lobby me seepage hai

body:
## Judwa bachcho ki neend ka routine — 4 mahine walo ke liye

Hi parents,

Is hafte KiasuParents forum par 4 mahine ke twins wale 5 maa-baap ne apne raat wale routine share kiye. Pura thread ka nichod neeche hai:

### 1. Dono ko ek saath sulao, alag-alag nahi

Ek ko sulate-sulate dusra jaag jata hai, ye sabke ghar ki kahani hai. Mummies bol rahi hain dono ka bedtime ek hi rakho — nahlao, kapde badlo, doodh pilao, phir light dim. Shuru me 3-4 din mushkil hoga, phir dono ek hi time par neend pakadne lagte hain.

### 2. Feed-log me 3 ghante ka gap pakdo

Raat ko baar-baar feed se neend toot jati hai. Ek papa ne apni feed diary ka photo dala — din me har 3 ghante par full feed, raat me last feed 10 baje ke aas-paas. Isse dono 3-4 ghante ka lamba stretch sone lage. Diary me time likhna mat chhodo, polyclinic me kaam aata hai.

### 3. White noise chalao, poore kamre me ek jaisi awaaz

Fan ki awaaz, white noise app ya purana phone — halki lagatar awaaz se ek bachche ke rone se dusra kam jaagta hai. Volume itna rakho jitne me tum aaram se baat kar sako, speaker bachcho ke sir ke paas mat rakho.

### 4. Kamre ka temp 25C rakho

Kai parents ne bola 25C par twins sabse ache se soye. Patli cotton ki romper, mota kambal nahi. AC nahi hai to fan + khidki khol kar hawa cross karwao, paseena aaye to kapda badal do.

### 5. Polyclinic nurse se kab poochna hai

Agar wazan badh raha hai par raat me har ghante jaag rahe hain, ya din me doodh peena kam kar diya hai, to agle weight check me nurse se pooch lo. Bukhar, ulti ya saans me awaaz ho to wait mat karo, turant clinic jao.

[Pura discussion padho](https://www.kiasuparents.com)

body:
## Arjun, 4 mahine ke teeke ke baad halka bukhar se ghabrana mat

Is hafte tumhare jaise naye maa-baap ke liye nurse wali khaas baatein lekar aaye hain — padho aur ghar me sukoon rakho.

### 1. 5-in-1 aur pneumococcal ke baad halka bukhar normal hai

Bahut se bachcho ko teeka lagne ke 24 ghante ke andar 37.5 se 38.2 tak halka bukhar aa jata hai. Ye is baat ka sign hai ki badan andar se ladna seekh raha hai. Teeka wali jagah par thodi sujan ya halka dard bhi 2 din tak reh sakta hai. Us jagah ko mat dabao, thande kapde se halke se sek kar sakte ho. Nurse ka kehna hai ki bachche ko zyada kapdo me mat lapeto, hawa aane do.

[ Bukhar wala guide padho ](https://hpb.gov.sg/baby-vaccine-aftercare )

### 2. Doodh pilane ka gap kaise rakhe?

Teeke ke baad kuch bachche ek feed chhod dete hain ya beech me so jate hain. Ghabrao mat, zabardasti mat pilao. Agle 24 ghante tak har 2 se 3 ghante me feed offer karo, chahe thoda hi piye. Agar bachcha lagatar 4 ghante se zyada soye aur doodh na mange, to halke se utha kar pilane ki koshish karo. Paani ya glucose dene ki zaroorat nahi hai, maa ka doodh ya formula hi kaafi hai.

### 3. Kab clinic jana zaroori hai?

- Bukhar 38.5 se upar jaye aur 48 ghante se zyada rahe
- Bachcha doodh bilkul na le ya peshab bahut kam kare
- Teeka wali jagah par laal ghera badhta jaye ya peep nikle
- Saans tez chale ya bachcha bahut sust lage

Aisa kuch dikhe to turant apne polyclinic ya GP ko dikhao. Halke bukhar ke liye khud se syrup mat shuru karo, pehle nurse se poochho.

[ Kab doctor ko dikhaye — checklist dekho ](https://hpb.gov.sg/when-to-see-doctor )

### 4. Tohfa: Neend-feed log ka 1-page chart

Raat me kaun kab utha, ye yaad rakhna mushkil hota hai. Isliye hamari nurse ne ek simple 1-page chart banaya hai — doodh ka time, neend ka time, peshab-potty ka tick. Print karke fridge par lagao, 10 Sep wale review me saath le jane me bhi kaam aayega.

**Muft download karo aur print nikalo**

[ Chart download karo ](https://hpb.gov.sg/feed-sleep-chart )

body:
## Ghutne ke dard me aaram ke liye ghar wali 5 aasaan exercise

Namaste, is hafte Healthy Ageing newsletter me hum baat kar rahe hai ghutne ke halke dard walo ke liye safe chair exercise ki. Roz sirf 10 minute do, aur dard ka hisaab rakhoge to doctor ko samjhane me bhi aasaan hoga.

### 1. Kursi par baith kar pair seedha karna

Mazboot kursi par kamar seedhi karke baitho, dono pair zameen par. Dheere se ek pair saamne seedha karo, 5 second roko, phir neeche lao. Dono taraf se **8-8 baar** karo. Ghutne me tez dard ho to itna upar mat uthao, jahan halka khinchao lage wahi bas hai.

### 2. Aedi uthana - calf raise ka halka version

Kursi ke pichhe khade ho kar halke se pakad lo. Dono aedi dheere se upar uthao, 3 second roko, phir wapas. **10 baar** dohrao. Ye jangh aur pindli ko mazboot karta hai, jisse chalne me ghutne par zor kam padta hai.

### 3. Baith kar march karna

Wahi kursi par baitho, kamar seedhi. Jaise hawa me march karte hai, ek-ek ghutna halka sa upar uthao, haath bhi halke hilao. **1 minute tak** dheere-dheere karo, saans normal rakho. Chakkar aaye to turant ruk jao aur paani pi lo.

### 4. Deewar ke sahare aadha squat

Deewar se peeth tika kar khade ho, pair thoda aage. Ghutne ko bahut aage nikale bina thoda sa neeche jhuko, jaise kursi par baithne ja rahe ho, phir wapas khade. **6 baar** karo. Dard 5 me se 3 se zyada lage to mat karo.

### 5. Lete-lete ghutne ke neeche tolna

Bistar par seedha leto, ek ghutne ke neeche mudi hui tauliya rakho. Ghutne ko tauliye par dabao, pair ki ungli upar ki taraf kheecho, 5 second roko. Har pair se **8 baar**. Ye physio wale aksar sujan walo ko batate hai.

[Physio video yahan dekho - 6 minute](https://www.hpb.gov.sg/knee-care-video)

### Roz 10 minute ka simple routine

Subah chai ke baad ya shaam ko TV dekhte time ye order rakho: pehle march 1 minute se garam ho jao, phir 1 aur 5 wali baithne-lietne wali exercise karo, aakhir me deewar wala aur aedi wala khade wala karo. Beech me 30 second aaram lo. Hafte me 5 din karo, 2 din pair ko rest do.

### Garam sek kaise karein, safe tarika

- Garam paani ki thaili ko patle tauliye me lapet kar **15 minute** se zyada mat rakho
- Din me 2 baar se zyada zaroorat nahi, khaana khane ke turant baad mat karo
- Jalan, laal daag ya sujan badhe to sek band karke doctor ko batao
- Dard wali cream sek ke saath mat lagao, ek time me ek hi cheez karo

### Aaj dopahar follow-up hai to dard diary aise likho

Aaj **16 September ko 2:20 baje Jurong Polyclinic me knee follow-up** hai, to ye 3 line likh kar le jao to doctor ko clear hoga:

- **Kab dard hua:** jaise subah seedhi utarte time, raat ko sote time
- **Kitna dard:** 0 se 10 me number do, 0 matlab bilkul nahi, 10 matlab bahut tez
- **Kya karne se aaram mila:** jaise sek se, baithne se, tel malish se

Chhoti diary ka photo le lo, booklet ke saath dikhane me kaam ayega.

[Dard diary ka free print nikalo](https://www.hpb.gov.sg/pain-diary-print)

### 4 mahine ke judwa bachcho ki neend ka routine kaise set karein?

Namaste Arjun,

judwa bachche 4 mahine ke ho jayein to raat bhar jaagna sabse mushkil lagta hai. Is hafte humne do bachcho wale gharo ke liye simple routine wale ideas jode hain, jo Jurong me rehne wali kai families try kar rahi hain.

### 1. Raat me 2 feed se 1 feed par kaise aayein? 3 aasan tareeke

**Pehla tareeka: Dream feed pakka karo**
Raat 10:30 - 11 baje ke aas-paas, bachcho ko poora jagaye bina halka feed de do. Dono ko ek hi time par uthao, taaki ek soye aur dusra jaage wala chakkar khatam ho. 4-5 din me dono ki neend lambi hone lagti hai.

**Dusra tareeka: Din ka feed gap thoda tight karo**
Din me har 3 ghante par pet bhar feed do, shaam 6 - 7 baje last nap ke baad ujala kam kar do. Jab din me calorie poori hogi to raat me ek feed apne aap chhoot jaati hai. Feed diary me time likhte raho, pattern 1 hafte me dikhega.

**Teesra tareeka: Ek-ek karke kam karo**
Dono bachcho ki dono feed ek saath band mat karo. Pehle Aarav aur Vivaan me se jo zyada der sota hai, uski 3 baje wali feed me doodh thoda kam kar do. 3-4 din me woh feed chhod dega, phir dusre par same try karo.

[Poora sleep guide padho](https://theasianparent.com/sg)

### 2. Nazla-khansi me doctor ko kab dikhaye? Checklist

- Bukhar 38 degree se upar ho aur 24 ghante se kam na ho
- Feed aadhi se kam le raha ho ya peshaab 6 ghante se na hua ho
- Saans tez chal rahi ho, seene me ghargharahat ho
- Naak band hone se dono feed chhoot rahi hon

Halke nazle me saline drop aur kamre me hawa ka flow kaafi hai. Antibiotics khud se shuru mat karo.

## Drypers Baby Club - Papa Special Tips

Hello Papa Arjun,

judwa bachcho ke saath M size chal raha hai na? Bahut sare papa humse poochte hain — M se L par kab shift karein? Aaj humne 5 aasan nishani likhi hain, taaki leak aur rashes se pehle hi aap ready raho.

### M se L size par switch ke 5 sanket

**1. Kamar par laal nishan padna**  
Diaper kholne par agar elastic ka gehara nishan dikhe, matlab fit tight ho gaya hai.

**2. Baar-baar side se leak hona**  
Peshab thigh ke side se bahar aaye to absorbency ka issue nahi, size chhota pad raha hai.

**3. Wazan 7kg ke upar ho jana**  
Drypers M 6-11kg tak hai, par 7-8kg ke baad bahut active babies ko L me zyada comfort milta hai.

**4. Velcro pet ke bilkul side me lagna**  
Tape agar beech me chipakne ki jagah bilkul kone tak ja raha hai, to next size ka time hai.

**5. Raat me 2 baar se zyada change karna pade**  
Din me theek hai par raat me bhar jata hai to L size + overnight fit try karo.

### Raat bhar dry rakhne ke 2 tried tips

- Sone se pehle wala diaper thoda fresh lagao, chahe 1 ghanta pehle change kiya ho. Raat ka 8-10 ghante ka gap lamba hota hai.
- Diaper ke frill ko andar se bahar ki taraf nikaal do — ye chhoti si cheez leak ko bahut kam karti hai.

body:
## Pigeon Baby SG - Chhote Sipahi, Badi Samajh

Namaste Arjun,

Judwa Aarav aur Vivaan ab 4 mahine ke hone wale hain, to bottle ke nipple ka size badalne ka time aa gaya hai. Bahut parents late badalte hain, phir baby ko doodh kheenchne me zor lagta hai aur woh ro deta hai.

### 3 mahine wala rule samjho

Pigeon Softouch nipple me **SS size newborn ke liye hai, S size 1 mahine se upar ke liye**. Aam taur par **3 mahine tak SS se S par shift** kar do. Flow thoda tez hoga, par baby ko atakna nahi padega.

Dono bachcho ke liye alag-alag nipple rakho aur har 2-3 mahine me check karo - silicone patla ya chipka lage to turant badal do.

### Doodh atakne ke 4 sanket

- **1. Chuste-chuste so jana:** pet bhara nahi, thak gaya hai
- **2. Bahut awaaz ke saath chusna:** hawa andar ja rahi hai, baad me gas hoga
- **3. 30 min se zyada ek feed lena:** flow slow hai
- **4. Nipple ko kaatna ya kheenchna:** baby irritate ho raha hai

Agar inme se 2 bhi dikhe, to S size try karke dekho.

### Sterilizer me ubalne ka sahi time

Bahut log 15-20 minute ubalte hain, usse silicone jaldi kharab hota hai. Sahi tareeka:

- **Ubalta paani me sirf 5 minute** rakho
- Chhimte se nikalo, sukhi jaali par sukhne do
- Steam sterilizer hai to ek cycle hi kaafi hai

Seedha cooker me ubaalne ke bajaye, dhuli bottle ko ulta karke halki dhup ya hawa me 30 minute sukhne do. Band geele dabbe me turant mat rakho.

## Diaper wali jagah par daane kyun nikalte hain?

Namaste, naye papa-mummy ke liye chhoti si guide lekar aaye hain. Judwa bachchon me diaper change din me 8-10 baar hota hai, to skin ka laal hona bahut normal hai. Thoda sahi tareeka apna lo to daane jaldi sukhte hain.

### 1. Cream lagane ka sahi 2-ungli rule

Bahut saari cream lagane se fayda nahi hota. Apni do ungli par lambi patli line jitni cream lo, bas utni hi kaafi hai. Dono judwa ke liye alag-alag haath se lagao taaki infection ek se doosre tak na jaaye. Cream ko moti parat me mat lagao, patli parat me lagao taaki skin saans le sake. [Barrier cream kaise lagayein](https://www.mustela.sg)

### 2. Har change par paani se ponchho, tissue se ragdo mat

Sookhe tissue se zor se ragadne par nanhi skin chhil jaati hai. Behtar hai naram cotton ya geele wipe se halke haath se dab kar ponchho. Ghar par ho to halke garam paani se dho kar towel se thap-thapa kar sukhao, phir 1-2 minute diaper khula chhod do. Hawa lagne se daane bahut jaldi kam hote hain. Raat wale change me ye 2 minute wala gap zaroor rakho.

### 3. Kab doctor ko dikhana hai?

- Daana 3 din me kam na ho
- Chhote safed daane ya peep dikhe
- Bachcha peshab par roye
- Bukhar ke saath rash ho

Aisa lage to polyclinic me dikha dena, cream apne aap mat badalna.

- **S (3-7 kg)** - newborn se thoda bada
- **M (6-11 kg)** - 4-6 mahine wale babies ke liye most common

body:
## KKR Insider - Knight Club Letter

Namaste Arjun, kal raat wala phone par dekha match yaad hai na? Dil ki dhadkan ruk gayi thi last 2 over me!

### 28 Sep wale match ke 5 sabse tez pal

**1. Powerplay me doosri ball par chhakka**
Pehla over tight gaya tha, sab soch rahe the slow start hoga. Phir doosre over ki doosri ball par Rinku ne length ball ko uthaya aur long-on ke upar se seedha stand me. Poora momentum wahi se palta.

**2. 7th over wala double run-out chance**
Fielding dekhne layak thi. Narine ka throw aur keeper ka kaam ek second ka khel tha. Ek run bacha liya, nahi to 15 run ka over ho jata. Yehi chhoti cheez match banati hai.

**3. 12th over me spinner ka double jhatka**
Lagatar do ball par set batsman out. Pehli googly par bowled, doosri par slip me catch. Crowd ka shor phone me bhi suna hoga tumne. Uske baad opposite team 3 over tak sambhal hi nahi payi.

**4. 18th over wala 22 run ka over**
Russell aaya aur pehli teen ball par 6, 4, 6. Bowler line bhool gaya. Hum log food court me bhi hote to kaam chhod kar dekhte. Ye over ne target ko seedha chase me la diya.

**5. Last over ki teesri ball par jeet wala chhakka**
6 ball par 14 chahiye tha. Do ball par 8 aaye. Teesri ball full toss nahi thi, yorker miss hui aur Rinku ne mid-wicket ke upar se uthaya. Ball gayi, match aaya!

### Jeet wale khiladi se khaas baat

**Sawaal: Last over me dimaag me kya chal raha tha?**
Jawaab: Main sirf ball dekh raha tha. Socha tha ek boundary aayegi to pressure bowler par aa jayega. Chhakka lagte hi saari thakaan nikal gayi.

**Sawaal: Agle match ki taiyaari?**

body:
## 4 mahine ke baad teeka ke baad bukhar? Ghabrao mat

Namaste papa,

21 Sep wala **5-in-1 + pneumococcal teeka** lagne ke baad agar Aarav ya Vivaan ko halka bukhar ya pair me sujan aayi hai, to tension mat lo — ye bahut aam hai.

Jurong Polyclinic wali nurse ke hisaab se 24-48 ghante me ye khud theek ho jata hai.

### 4 baat yaad rakho:

**1. Halka bukhar normal hai**
37.5 se 38.5 tak bukhar ka matlab body teeka se ladna seekh rahi hai. Dono bachcho ko alag-alag check karo, ek ko ho aur dusre ko na ho, ye bhi normal hai.

**2. Paani aur doodh pilate raho**
Feed thoda-thoda karke zyada baar do. Paseena aaye to geele kapde se halke haath se ponchh do. Mota kambal mat lapeto.

**3. Teeka wali jagah par kya karna hai**
Jangh par halki laali ya gath ho sakti hai. Baraf seedha mat lagao, saaf geela kapda 2-3 minute rakho. Zor se malna mat.

**4. Clinic kab jana hai**
Agar bukhar 39 se upar jaye, 2 din se zyada rahe, doodh bilkul na piye, ya bahut zyada roye aur chup na ho — to turant polyclinic ya GP ko dikhao. Health booklet me 21 Sep wala stamp page saath le jana.

Agla teeka 6 mahine par hai — hum time par yaad dilayenge.

[Aage ke teeka ka schedule dekho](https://babycentre.sg/vaccine-guide)

**Baby Centre SG Team**

## Pigeon Singapore - Mama-Papa Club

Judwa baby walo ke ghar me bottle ka chakkar to din bhar chalta rehta hai na? Ek soye to dusra uth jaata hai. Is hafte hum laaye hain time bachane wale simple tareeke, specially twin parents ke liye.

### 1. Din me 8-10 baar bottle dhone ka shortcut

Har baar full sterilize karne ki tension mat lo. Pigeon ke experts bolte hain:

- Feed ke turant baad bottle ko garam paani se khangalo, doodh chipakne mat do
- Din me ek baar alag tub me halka liquid cleanser se brush se saaf karo, nipple ko ulta karke dho lo

- Doodh peete-peete so jaate hain ya bahut zor lagate hain
- 20 minute se zyada ek feed me lag raha hai
- Nipple chaba rahe hain, chus nahi rahe

To samjho SS se S size par shift ka time aa gaya hai. Aam taur par 3-4 mahine par change hota hai, par judwa me ek ka pehle bhi ho sakta hai, dusre ka baad me. Dono ko alag-alag dekho.

### 3. Raat wali feed ke baad gas nikalne ke 3 tip

Raat ko gas nahi nikli to poori neend kharab. Ye 3 try karo:

**1. Kandhe wala burp:** 10 minute seedha kandhe par rakho, halki thapki do. Jaldi leta mat karo.

**2. God me bitha kar:** Pair latka kar apni jaangh par bithao, ek haath seene par, dusre se peeth sehlo.

**3. Aadhi feed me break:** Poori bottle ek saath mat pilao, aadhi ke baad burp karwao phir baaki pilao. Ulatiyan kam hongi.
